view.scene_description: A brightly lit convenience store aisle with shelves stocked with snacks and packaged goods. A man in a white shirt browses near a fruit display of oranges. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. The perspective is slightly blurred on the right, suggesting motion or shallow depth of field.

objects.label: man
objects.observation: Wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, he stands at a fruit display, reaching toward oranges. His back faces the camera, and he appears focused on selecting items. He is positioned left-center in the frame, partially obscuring the fruit display.

objects.label: fruit display
objects.observation: A wooden-framed basket filled with bright orange fruits, likely oranges, sits on a shelf. It is located in the lower-left foreground, directly in front of the man. The basket rests on a shelf, supported by the store’s shelving system.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Metal shelves extend along both sides of the aisle, heavily stocked with colorful snack boxes and packaged goods. The right side is more blurred due to motion or shallow focus. Shelves are mounted to the wall and ceiling structure, supporting products above and below.

objects.label: decorative hot air balloons
objects.observation: Several stylized hot air balloon decorations hang from the ceiling, featuring pastel colors like yellow and green. They are suspended by wires or cords, positioned above the aisle, adding a playful ambiance to the store environment.

objects.label: fluorescent lighting
objects.observation: Long, rectangular fluorescent light fixtures are mounted to the black ceiling, providing bright illumination. They run parallel to the aisle, evenly spaced, and cast a clean, even glow over the entire scene.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
